title: OpenClaw agent tool-surface diagnostic
description: Isolate openclaw.cmd agent behavior with two minimal fresh-session probes: one read-only prompt and one exact write-tool prompt. Capture raw JSON/text output, verify filesystem side effects, and publish enough evidence to determine whether the agent sees and uses the expected tools consistently.
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root='C:/3EN-Agent/workbench/diag-057q';$readSource=Join-Path $root 'read-source.txt';$writeTarget=Join-Path $root 'write-target.txt';Remove-Item $writeTarget -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;function RunAgent([string]$tag,[string]$prompt){$session='3en-057q-'+$tag+'-'+[guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N');$raw=@(& openclaw.cmd agent --session-key $session --message $prompt --json --timeout 180 2>&1);$ec=$LASTEXITCODE;$txt=($raw|ForEach-Object{[string]$_}) -join [Environment]::NewLine;$txt|Set-Content (Join-Path $root ('agent-'+$tag+'-raw.txt')) -Encoding UTF8;Write-Output ('V450_057Q_'+$tag.ToUpper()+'_EXIT='+$ec);foreach($line in $raw){Write-Output ('V450_057Q_'+$tag.ToUpper()+'_OUT='+[string]$line)};if($ec -ne 0){throw ('057Q_'+$tag.ToUpper()+'_EXIT_'+$ec)};return $txt};$readPrompt='Read exactly C:/3EN-Agent/workbench/diag-057q/read-source.txt and reply with exactly its single line. Do not create files. Do not propose skills.';$readOut=RunAgent 'read' $readPrompt;$readOk=($readOut -match 'READ_PROBE_CONTENT=ALPHA_057Q');Write-Output ('V450_057Q_READ_MATCH='+$readOk);$writePrompt='Use the write tool to create exactly C:/3EN-Agent/workbench/diag-057q/write-target.txt containing exactly one line: WRITE_PROBE_CONTENT=BETA_057Q . You must actually invoke the write tool. After success reply exactly WRITE_057Q_DONE.';$writeOut=RunAgent 'write' $writePrompt;$writeExists=Test-Path $writeTarget;$writeContent='';if($writeExists){$writeContent=(Get-Content $writeTarget -Raw).Trim()};$writeOk=($writeExists -and $writeContent -eq 'WRITE_PROBE_CONTENT=BETA_057Q');Write-Output ('V450_057Q_WRITE_EXISTS='+$writeExists);Write-Output ('V450_057Q_WRITE_CONTENT='+$writeContent);$cfg=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.openclaw/openclaw.json';$primary='';if(Test-Path $cfg){try{$c=Get-Content $cfg -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;$primary=[string]$c.agents.defaults.model.primary}catch{$primary='CONFIG_PARSE_ERROR'}};[pscustomobject]@{testedAt=(Get-Date).ToString('o');primary=$primary;readMatch=$readOk;writeExists=$writeExists;writeContent=$writeContent;writeMatch=$writeOk;readRawFile='agent-read-raw.txt';writeRawFile='agent-write-raw.txt'}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5|Set-Content (Join-Path $root 'diagnostic.json') -Encoding UTF8;Write-Output ('V450_057Q_PRIMARY='+$primary)
